messages.author: bce99ba71cd48eea
messages.subject: Re: Subread not able to perform alignment ?
parts:
I'm not sure what is the step of running where Subread got stuck since you're using the very basic setting for running Subread-align. 

Would it be possible to start subread-align using gdb? Like

$ gdb ./subread-align

> set args -T 5  -i  /data/subread-1.6.2-Linux-x86_64/index/hg38  -r /data/Chi-son/lastl/SRR_R1.fastq -R /data/Chi-son/lastl/SRR_R2.fastq -t 1 -o /data/subread-1.6.2-Linux-x86_64/SRR.subread1.sam 

> run

When it got stuck, just press Ctrl+C to stop it, and use  the where command to see the current location of the source code.

By the way, I noticed that your output file is a SAM file. You should use the "--SAMoutput" option to actually generate a SAM-formated output, or the file format will still be BAM although the file name suffix is ".sam".
